job.name: The Bulwark (class portrait)
job.use: A portrait for the class card and the level-3 choice; today the class shows its code-drawn emblem only
job.paint: A broad, steady person in scuffed plate with a Buckler on the forearm, planted in a doorway, looking past the viewer at what is coming; warm firelight from one side.
job.avoid: a recognisable knight from any known work · a raised sword pose
job.prompt:
Create an original Project Heaven Cry illustration in HEAVENPRINT. Use the attached approved Original 27 and New Faces
images as the painting authority: expressive ink and opaque gouache, deliberate angular form, selective dry-brush
scumbling, restrained hatching, charcoal lost edges and warm ivory accents. Faces have believable anatomy and restrained
stylization and specific emotional acting. Format: 4:5, 800 x 1000 PNG, one character from the chest or waist up, one
visible action, one specific emotion, one useful setting hint behind them; the eye line about 22% from the top. The class
attribute's pigment appears only as one accent (given in the section). No text, frame, UI or watermark; no real-world
person, brand or recognisable character. The portrait shows:

Paint: A broad, steady person in scuffed plate with a Buckler on the forearm, planted in a doorway, looking past the viewer at what is coming; warm firelight from one side.
Avoid: a recognisable knight from any known work · a raised sword pose
CAST AND STAGING: Bulwark: broad 50-year-old woman with deep brown skin, a wide weathered face, close-braided gray-black hair and tired alert eyes. Waist-up, shoulders square but head turned slightly toward something beyond viewer. Scuffed ivory ceramic and charcoal iron plate over practical dark cloth; ONE ROUND BUCKLER on forward forearm held across lower chest, other bare hand braced against rough doorway jamb. Warm firelight from left gives natural warm skin planes; cooler neutral doorway behind. Eye line22% from top. No raised sword, medieval heraldry, helmet, familiar franchise armor, pose copied from references or decorative emblem badge. Show the shield motif through actual useful equipment.
ACTING SENTENCE: A broad veteran holds the doorway because something is approaching, and feels steady protective resolve.
Rendering follows the approved paintings: visible deliberate angular opaque gouache brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry scumbling, quiet charcoal lost edges and warm ivory focal planes. Believable face anatomy with restrained illustration stylization, no photo skin/3D gloss/airbrush, no oversized anime eyes. Borrow rendering, NEVER the identity/face/pose/costume of a reference person. The final small motif reference supplies only the class's equipment/gesture motif; DO NOT paste its emblem/frame into painting. Vertical 4:5, full-bleed opaque RGB painting, chest/waist-up, eye line approximately22% from top, face/decisive hands/tool central80%. One person, action, emotion, useful setting hint. Preserve natural skin/cloth/metal colors; one small crimson-red #CC2435 accent in a repaired shoulder strap is the SINGLE ATTRIBUTE ACCENT, never a monochrome wash. No letters, readable glyphs, labels, symbols of real faiths, real insignia, caption, UI, frame, border or watermark.
